lines.say: They took your car. You still owe eleven grand?

lines.text: After a default, many states let the lender take the car without a court order, often with no warning.
lines.say: After a default, many states let the lender take the car without a court order, often with no warning.

lines.text: It's usually sold at auction, often for less than you owe.
lines.say: It's usually sold at auction, often for less than you owe.

lines.text: Say you owe $20,000. It sells for $12,000, and repo and sale fees add $1,500.
lines.say: Say you owe twenty thousand dollars. It sells for twelve thousand, and repo and sale fees add fifteen hundred.

lines.text: Now you owe $9,500, with no car. That's a deficiency balance.
lines.say: Now you owe ninety-five hundred dollars, with no car. That's a deficiency balance.

lines.text: The CFPB found the average leftover balance was $11,340 in December 2022.
lines.say: The C F P B found the average leftover balance was eleven thousand three hundred forty dollars in December twenty twenty-two.

lines.text: A repo can stay on your credit report up to 7 years.
lines.say: A repo can stay on your credit report up to seven years.

lines.text: Cox Automotive estimated about 1.73 million repos in 2024.
lines.say: Cox Automotive estimated about one point seven three million repos in twenty twenty-four.

lines.text: The CFPB says to contact your lender early if you can't pay.

post.title: Your car gets repossessed. You can still owe thousands.
post.ig:
Your car gets repossessed. You can still owe thousands. The average was $11,340.
After a default, in many states a lender can take the car without a court order. It's usually sold at auction, often for less than you owe.
Example: owe $20,000, car sells for $12,000, $1,500 in fees = $9,500 deficiency balance, and no car.
CFPB: the average deficiency balance was $11,340 in Dec 2022. A repo can stay on your credit report up to 7 years. Cox Automotive estimated about 1.73M repos in 2024.
Sources: CFPB; Cox Automotive.
